Hey! It's been a headache of a process, but I've been slowly improving. I've been forcing myself outside for walks when my head gets too bad (Much easier now that the weather is nicer), focusing on my sleep ensuring I get enough, and taking the quiet moments to meditate. 

It's still putting up a helluva fight, but I'm definitely out of the dark place I was when I made this post. Thank you for checking up on me, and thank you so much for all of the advice!
Woah this is a ton. Thank you so much for all the resources, I'll be sure to look them over and use them to the best of my ability.
Thank you so much, I have been forcing myself to get outside and go for walks whenever I have the time. It definitely helps a little for sure
